title: OMS Closure Predicate v0.1 (Draft)
description: JSON Schema for the optional closure predicate body (spec/closure/v0.1.md). Unknown fields are ignored per the in-toto parsing rules. Rules a schema cannot express, such as unique URIs and unique resource names, are in Section 3 of the spec.

dependencies.description: The model's whole closure is flattened. An empty array declares that the loader fetches nothing from outside the model directory.

uri.description: The source from which the loader fetches the dependency. Compared byte for byte.

kind.description: What the loader does with the dependency.

resources.description: Files of the dependency, one whole file resource descriptor each.

claimed_signer.description: The identity the producer expects to have signed the dependency. An assertion, not a trust root.

public_key_sha256.description: Key: SHA-256 of the DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo, lowercase hex.

root_certificate_sha256.description: Certificate: SHA-256 of the DER-encoded root certificate, lowercase hex.

identity.description: Sigstore: Subject Alternative Name of the signing certificate.

issuer.description: Sigstore: OIDC issuer recorded in the signing certificate.
